facts.value: Returns NULL when ftCo_800A2040(fp) is true and (signed) fp->cpu.xC equals 28. Otherwise scans grabbable, compatible items of enabled weight classes and requires strict overlap of the offset grab boxes. Heavy items use the heavy region even for an airborne fighter. Only dist_sq < the current minimum, initially 30000, selects a candidate; ties retain earlier list order. No local state transition or reservation occurs.
facts.rationale: Correct object-specific storage, exact field spelling, consumed event semantics or callback scope.

facts.value: Clears throw flags and changes to the supplied motion at frame zero and zero blend. HeavyGet uses the scale-transformed playback rate; other IDs use one. False loop advances once; true advances repeatedly until throw bit 3 is consumed and cleared. Only afterward sets itemget.x0 and the heavy/ordinary damage callback. The later Anim callback makes a fresh weight-filtered search on a new acquisition event; the entry candidate is not reserved.

facts.value: Directly assigns the supplied item to the primary slot when empty, otherwise to x1978, then notifies pickup and attaches/presents the item. It does not locally change fighter motion or validate an already occupied secondary slot. Delegated fighter/item pickup callbacks can have their own effects. Non-heavy Warp Star uses TopN, other light items use the light part, and heavy items use the heavy part and sound.

facts.value: Consumes and clears throw bit 3, then searches for a current light-only or heavy-only candidate according to itemget.x0 and attaches a returned item. This is a fresh search, not the original entry candidate. At animation exhaustion reads x1978 before item_gobj, motion ID and x2222_b0 to select immediate effects, heavy holding or common neutral completion.

facts.value: The 80094790 entry path requires a free secondary slot and an eligible nearby item, then enters LightGet or HeavyGet. It does not reserve that candidate: the animation acquisition event consumes throw bit 3 and searches again by weight class. Completion resolves immediate effects or heavy holding; separate collision failure cleans up and enters Fall. Direct transfer and immediate-effect helpers also serve aerial acquisition callers.
